NRN44.1. Nursing Clinical IV (4) 
Pass/No Pass Only

of C or better.

Semesters Offered:  Variable 
Using the Roy Adaptation Model with the 
nursing process as a framework for 
providing nursing care, students care for 3-

increasingly complex alterations in the 
acute care and community-based settings. 
Emphasis is on the management of 
complex clients and nursing leadership. 
[CSU]
